name: Editing Reality
description: In-situ co-creation with generative AI in mixed reality
title: Editing Reality: Designing In-Situ Co-Creation with Generative AI in Mixed Reality
booktitle: Proceedings of the 2026 Designing Interactive Systems Conference
bodyContent:
# Abstract

Editing Reality explores generative AI as part of an embodied, situated creative process in mixed reality. The system lets users iteratively co-create inside a physical room, treating generation as a spatial design material rather than a one-shot command on a screen.
